info.name: ExpressAndMongoose API
info.description: Full API collection for the Express & Mongoose project. Includes Auth, Users, Products, and Categories endpoints with all parameters, query options, and request bodies.

item.name: Health & Info
item.description: General server health and info endpoints.

request.description: Root endpoint – returns a welcome message and the current environment.
Returns server health status, timestamp, and environment.
Returns about page info and current port number.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints: register, login, get profile, and update password.

request.description:
Register a new user. Returns a JWT token on success.

**Body fields:**
- `firstName` (required, string, 2-50 chars)
- `lastName` (required, string, 2-50 chars)
- `email` (required, valid email, unique)
- `password` (required, min 8 chars)
- `age` (optional, number, 0-100)

Login with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

**Body fields:**
- `email` (required)
- `password` (required)

Get the currently logged-in user's profile.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Update the current user's password. Returns a new JWT token.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `currentPassword` (required)
- `newPassword` (required)

Send a 6-digit OTP to the user's email address for password reset.

**Body fields:**
- `email` (required, valid email)

Verify the OTP sent to the user's email. Must be called before reset-password.

**Body fields:**
- `email` (required, valid email)
- `otp` (required, 6-digit string)

Reset the user's password after OTP verification. Returns a new JWT token.

**Body fields:**
- `email` (required, valid email)
- `newPassword` (required, min 8 chars)

query.description: Page number (default: 1)
Results per page (default: 10, max: 100)
Sort field(s). Prefix with - for descending. Comma-separated for multiple (e.g. firstName,-createdAt)
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response
Search across firstName, lastName, email (regex, case-insensitive)

request.description:
Get all users with filtering, sorting, field selection, search, and pagination.

**Query parameters:**
- `page` – page number (default: 1)
- `limit` – results per page (default: 10)
- `sort` – sort field(s), prefix `-` for descending
- `fields` – comma-separated field names to select
- `search` – regex search across firstName, lastName, email
- Any model field can be used as a filter (e.g. `role=admin`, `age[gte]=18`)

Get a single user by their MongoDB ObjectId.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

Create a new user.

**Body fields:**
- `firstName` (required, string, 2-30 chars)
- `lastName` (required, string, 2-30 chars)
- `email` (required, valid email)
- `password` (required, min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, and a number)
- `age` (optional, integer, 13-120)
- `role` (optional, one of: user, admin, moderator)

Update a user by ID (partial update).

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `firstName` (string, 2-30 chars)
- `lastName` (string, 2-30 chars)
- `email` (valid email)
- `age` (integer, 13-120)

Delete a user by ID. Also deletes all products created by the user and removes their reviews from other products.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

query.description: Page number (default: 1, min: 1)
Results per page (default: 20, min: 1, max: 100)
Sort option. Allowed: name, -name, createdAt, -createdAt
Search by category name (regex, case-insensitive)

request.description:
Get all categories with pagination, sorting, and search.

**Query parameters:**
- `page` – page number (default: 1)
- `limit` – results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `sort` – one of: name, -name, createdAt, -createdAt
- `search` – search by category name (case-insensitive regex)

Get a single category by its MongoDB ObjectId.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

Create a new category.

**Body fields:**
- `name` (required, string, 2-50 chars, unique)
- `description` (optional, string, max 200 chars)

Update a category by ID (partial update).

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `name` (string, 2-50 chars)
- `description` (string, max 200 chars)

Delete a category by ID. Also deletes all products in this category.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

item.name: Products
item.description: CRUD operations for products. Create, update, and delete require authentication. Products use a variant-based schema with colors, images (URLs), and per-size pricing/stock.

query.description: Page number (default: 1)
Results per page (default: 10, max: 100)
Sort field(s). Allowed: basePrice, -basePrice, name, -name, createdAt, -createdAt, ratings.average, -ratings.average
Comma-separated field names to include in response
Search across name, description, brand, tags (regex, case-insensitive)
Minimum price filter (validated as positive float)
Maximum price filter (validated as positive float)
Filter by category string (e.g. hoodies, t-shirts, jackets)
Filter by brand name
Filter by gender: male, female, or unisex
Filter by status: active, inactive, or draft
Base price greater than or equal to
Base price less than or equal to

request.description:
Get all products with advanced filtering, sorting, field selection, search, and pagination.

**Query parameters:**
- `page` – page number (default: 1)
- `limit` – results per page (default: 10, max: 100)
- `sort` – sort field(s): basePrice, -basePrice, name, -name, createdAt, -createdAt, ratings.average, -ratings.average
- `fields` – comma-separated field names to select
- `search` – regex search across name, description, brand, tags
- `minPrice` / `maxPrice` – price range filter
- `category` – filter by category string
- `brand` – filter by brand name
- `gender` – male, female, or unisex
- `status` – active, inactive, or draft
- Supports MongoDB operators via bracket notation: `basePrice[gte]=10`, `basePrice[lte]=100`

Get a single product by its MongoDB ObjectId.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

Create a new product with variant-based schema.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `name` (required, string, 2-150 chars)
- `description` (optional, string, max 1000 chars)
- `category` (required, string, e.g. "hoodies", "t-shirts")
- `brand` (required, string)
- `tags` (optional, array of strings)
- `gender` (optional, one of: male, female, unisex – default: unisex)
- `variants` (required, array of variant objects):
  - `variantId` (required, string)
  - `color` (required, object: `name`, `hex`)
  - `images` (optional, array: `url`, `view`)
  - `sizes` (required, array: `size`, `sku`, `stock`, `price`)
- `basePrice` (required, positive number)
- `currency` (optional, 3-letter code, default: USD)
- `discountPercent` (optional, 0-100)
- `sizeGuide` (optional, object: `unit`, `chart[]`)
- `material` (optional, string)
- `careInstructions` (optional, array of strings)
- `status` (optional, one of: active, inactive, draft – default: active)

Create a product with only the required fields.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Required fields:** name, category, brand, variants (min 1 with variantId, color, sizes), basePrice.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Classic Oversized Hoodie V2",
  "description": "Updated premium cotton blend hoodie.",
  "discountPercent": 15,
  "tags": ["oversized", "casual", "unisex", "sale"],
  "status": "active"
}

request.description:
Update a product by ID (partial update). All fields are optional.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

**Body fields (all optional):**
- `name` (string, 2-150 chars)
- `description` (string, max 1000 chars)
- `category` (string)
- `brand` (string)
- `tags` (array of strings)
- `gender` (male, female, unisex)
- `variants` (array of variant objects)
- `basePrice` (positive number)
- `currency` (3-letter code)
- `discountPercent` (0-100)
- `sizeGuide` (object)
- `material` (string)
- `careInstructions` (array of strings)
- `status` (active, inactive, draft)

Update only the variants of a product. Replaces the entire variants array.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

**Body:**
- `variants` (array of variant objects with variantId, color, images, sizes)

Delete a product by ID.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

formdata.description: Single main image for the variant (front/back/side)
Multiple gallery images for the variant
View type for the main image (e.g. front, back, side)

request.description:
Upload images for a specific product variant. Supports a single main image and/or multiple gallery images.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path parameters:**
- `id` – product MongoDB ObjectId
- `variantId` – the variant's variantId string

**Body (form-data):**
- `image` (file, optional) – single main image
- `gallery` (file[], optional) – multiple gallery images
- `view` (text, optional) – view type for the main image (default: front)

item.name: Cart
item.description: Shopping cart operations. All endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
Get the current user's cart with populated product details.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Add an item to the cart. If the same product+variant+size already exists, the quantity is increased.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `productId` (required, MongoDB ObjectId)
- `variantId` (required, string – must match a variant on the product)
- `size` (required, string – must match an available size in the variant)
- `quantity` (optional, positive integer, default: 1)

Update the quantity of a specific cart item. Set quantity to 0 to remove the item.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `productId` (required, MongoDB ObjectId)
- `variantId` (required, string)
- `size` (required, string)
- `quantity` (required, non-negative integer – 0 removes the item)

Remove a specific item from the cart.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `productId` (required, MongoDB ObjectId)
- `variantId` (required, string)
- `size` (required, string)

Remove all items from the cart.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: Wishlist operations. All endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
Get the current user's wishlist with populated product details.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Add a product to the wishlist. Duplicates are rejected.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `productId` (required, MongoDB ObjectId)

Remove a specific product from the wishlist.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path parameters:**
- `productId` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

Remove all products from the wishlist.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Order management. All endpoints require authentication. Users can place orders from their cart, view order history, get receipts, and cancel orders.

request.description:
Create a new order from the user's cart. The cart must contain at least one item. Stock is validated and decremented, and the cart is cleared upon success.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `shippingAddress` (required) – firstName, lastName, email, address, city, postalCode, phone
- `payment` (required) – method (credit_card | debit_card | paypal | cash_on_delivery), transactionId (optional)
- `shippingCost` (optional, default: 0)
- `tax` (optional, default: 0)
- `notes` (optional, max 500 chars)

Create an order with cash on delivery payment. Payment status will be 'pending' until delivery.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

query.description: Page number (default: 1)
Items per page (default: 10, max: 100)
Sort field(s). Prefix with - for descending.
Filter by order status

request.description:
Get the current user's order history with pagination and filtering.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Query params:**
- `page` – page number
- `limit` – results per page
- `sort` – sort field(s), e.g. `-createdAt`, `totalAmount`
- `status` – filter by status (pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

Get full details of a specific order (receipt view). Includes all items, shipping address, payment info, and totals.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `orderId` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

Get full details of a specific order by its order number.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `orderNumber` – the order's unique number (e.g. ORD-XXXXXXX-XXXXXX)

Cancel a pending or confirmed order. Stock is restored and payment is marked as refunded if applicable.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `orderId` – valid MongoDB ObjectId

**Body fields:**
- `reason` (optional, max 500 chars) – cancellation reason

item.name: Payments
item.description: Stripe payment endpoints. Includes checkout session creation, webhook handling, and session verification.

request.description:
Create a Stripe Checkout Session from the authenticated user's cart. Returns a session ID and redirect URL.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `shippingAddress` (object, required) – firstName, lastName, email, street, city, state, zip
- `notes` (string, optional) – order notes

header.description: Stripe webhook signature header (set automatically by Stripe)

request.description:
Stripe webhook endpoint. Called by Stripe when payment events occur (e.g. checkout.session.completed). Verifies the webhook signature and fulfills the order.

**Auth:** None (called by Stripe, verified via stripe-signature header).

**Note:** This endpoint expects raw body (not JSON parsed). Do not call this manually — it is intended for Stripe's webhook system.

Verify a Stripe checkout session status. Used by the frontend confirmation page to check payment status and retrieve the associated order.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `sessionId` – Stripe checkout session ID (e.g. cs_test_...)

item.name: AI Design
item.description: AI-powered custom design generation. All endpoints require authentication.

request.description:
Check if the AI model is loaded and ready to accept requests. Returns load status and estimated wait time if warming up.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Generate a custom AI design on a product image. Creates a design record and calls the AI model.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Body fields:**
- `productId` (required, MongoDB ObjectId)
- `variantId` (required, string)
- `prompt` (required, string, 3-500 chars)
- `strength` (optional, float 0.2-0.8, default: 0.55)

Retry a failed design generation. Only designs with status 'failed' can be retried.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `id` - valid MongoDB ObjectId of the failed design

Get all custom designs created by the current user, sorted by newest first.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

Get a single custom design by its ID.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**Path params:**
- `id` - valid MongoDB ObjectId
